new_learnings.text: K-type divergence signal: all 3 major indices green but breadth 0.29:1 with 72 limit-downs = indices carried by narrow large-cap tech names while broad market liquidates. Indices lie; breadth tells the truth. This is a 'no new positions' tape regardless of how green the indices look.
new_learnings.mechanism: Large-cap index weights (宁德时代, 中际旭创, etc.) can hold indices positive even when 77% of stocks decline. The K-type structure means traditional breadth indicators must override index signals for entry decisions.

new_learnings.text: Entry regime hard block is structurally preventing capital destruction. On a day where 4,245 stocks decline, the correct momentum decision is to deploy zero new capital regardless of individual candidate quality. V1's tendency to force 'small buys' in weak tapes was a root cause of underperformance.
new_learnings.mechanism: When breadth is below 1:1 with f10>30, even stocks with perfect setups face overwhelming sector/market gravity. The hard block converts 'temptation to buy' into 'mandatory cash preservation.'

new_learnings.text: 恒铭达 -4.48% single-day drop below all three MAs (MA5/MA10/MA20) with elevated volume is a textbook momentum rupture. The stop-proximity rule at 3.35% buffer is the only thing between this position and a forced exit. No thesis exceptions — if 83.55 breaches, exit immediately. Mechanical discipline > narrative.
new_learnings.mechanism: Momentum stocks that break below all short-term MAs on elevated volume signal institutional distribution. The 3.35% stop buffer is the final defense. Price below MA5/MA10/MA20 + volume surge = distribution, not consolidation.

new_learnings.text: 新宙邦 catalyst compounding: 宁德时代30万吨电解液3年协议 (+6.83% today, +19.2% total) vs. 恒铭达 consumer electronics components (-4.48% today).
